newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 28.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 28.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media & the Internet and Brand-name Products.
PARIS - Havas Advertising, the French advertising group, has forged a link with a French rugby club that experts say shows the growing importance of sports sponsorship. (Reuter) *********

PARIS - Canal J, a French television channel for children available only on cable or satellite networks, says it is running its first advertising campaign on terrestrial television from August 2 to August 10. (Reuter)

PARIS - Canal Plus hires Nathalie Ianetta to co-present its football news programme, a female face covering a male sport to replace Marianne Mako, who has been dropped by TF1 from its Telefoot programme. Liberation)

PARIS - LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault would accept 25 percent of a company blending LVMH's wine and spirits businesses with those of British groups Guinness and Grand Metropolitan, the French newspaper La Tribune, controlled by Arnault, reports. (Reuter)

OAK BROOK, Illinois - McDonald's Corp and Walt Disney Co, which launched an exclusive 10-year marketing alliance this year, have extended their agreement to include more co-branding activities, the companies say. As part of the new program, two McDonald's restaurants will open in Walt Disney World Resort in Florida and another restaurant will open at Disneyland Paris. (Reuter)
